other_mijikenda: Duruma: same name (Pakia App. VI); ndago also Swahili

teaser.en: The 'male sedge': short spikelets make it the husband of the longer-flowered ndago chetu.
teaser.sw: 'Ndago dume': vishada vyake vifupi vya maua vinaufanya kuwa mume wa ndago chetu, wenye maua marefu zaidi.

summary.en: Ndago lume is the Digo 'male sedge', a name for Mariscus sedges with short spikelets. The Digo pair it with ndago chetu, the 'female sedge', whose spikelets are longer.
summary.sw: Ndago lume ni 'ndago dume' wa Wadigo, jina la ndago za jenasi Mariscus zenye vishada vifupi vya maua. Wadigo huuunganisha na ndago chetu, 'ndago jike', ambao vishada vyake ni virefu zaidi.

about.en:
*Ndago lume* covers the *Mariscus* sedges, grass-like plants with solid, three-sided stems and leaves arranged in three ranks. At the top of the stem a ring of leafy bracts surrounds a head of small, short, crowded spikelets.

The Digo recognise it from the look of the whole plant.
about.sw:
*Ndago lume* hujumuisha ndago za jenasi *Mariscus*, mimea inayofanana na nyasi yenye mashina imara ya pembe tatu na majani yaliyopangwa kwa safu tatu. Juu ya shina, duara la vikombe-jani humzunguka kichwa cha vishada vidogo vifupi vya maua vilivyosongamana.

Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.

where.en: *Mariscus* sedges grow in grassland, bush clearings, farms and along paths on the coastal plain.
where.sw: Ndago za *Mariscus* huota nyikani, kwenye maeneo yaliyosafishwa vichakani, mashambani na kando ya njia katika nyanda za pwani.

uses.en: Pakia records that the Digo use the root nodules of *ndago* sedges (*Kyllinga* or *Cyperus*) to make a charm that gives magical strength in times of danger. He does not say whether *ndago lume* itself is used.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba Wadigo hutumia vinundu vya mizizi ya ndago (*Kyllinga* au *Cyperus*) kutengeneza hirizi inayotoa nguvu za kimiujiza wakati wa hatari. Hasemi kama *ndago lume* wenyewe hutumika.

culture.en: *Ndago* is the Digo word for sedges as a group, one of the few true folk genera in the language. Within it, the sexes are assigned by flower size: *ndago chetu*, the 'female', has longer spikelets, and *ndago lume*, the 'male', has shorter ones.
culture.sw: *Ndago* ni neno la Kidigo kwa jamii nzima ya ndago, mojawapo ya jenasi chache za kweli za kijadi katika lugha hiyo. Ndani yake, jinsia hupangwa kwa ukubwa wa maua: *ndago chetu*, wa 'kike', ana vishada virefu zaidi, na *ndago lume*, wa 'kiume', ana vifupi zaidi.

names.en: Pakia records *ndago lume*, 'male sedge', shared with Duruma and Swahili. *Ndago* itself is used in Digo, Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. No English name is recorded. Pakia's folk-genus table instead links *Mariscus* to *ndago munda*, so the match between names and sedges needs checking.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *ndago lume*, 'ndago dume', jina linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kiswahili. *Ndago* lenyewe hutumika kwa Kidigo, Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza lililoripotiwa. Jedwali la jenasi za kijadi la Pakia badala yake linahusisha *Mariscus* na *ndago munda*, kwa hiyo ulinganifu kati ya majina na ndago unahitaji kuthibitishwa.

reason.en: also a 'male' form named by flower size
reason.sw: nao ni aina ya 'kiume' iliyopewa jina kwa ukubwa wa maua

reason.en: grass of the same open country
